usedFor: 99 Acres holds property leads, and “New Leads” makes Google Drive run “Copy a File” for each one.

bestTemplate.name: “New Leads” in 99 Acres, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Each new lead gets its own copy of a chosen file, optionally under a new name.

watchOut: “Copy a File” in Google Drive copies one file you pick in setup, so keep that source file current.
